# DeepWiki

> > DeepWiki provides comprehensive technical documentation for software projects, with deep-dive coverage of Salesforce Lightning Web Components, PDF generation systems, and modern full-stack applications.

DeepWiki hosts detailed architectural documentation and implementation guides for complex software systems. Current coverage includes Salesforce development patterns (Lightning Web Components, Apex, Visualforce) and modern web applications built with Next.js, React, and PostgreSQL.

## Key Topics

- Lightning Web Components (LWC)
- Salesforce PDF Generation
- Apex Controllers
- Visualforce Templates
- Next.js Full-Stack Architecture
- System Architecture Patterns
- BillingPdfGenerate Service
- Clerk Authentication
- Drizzle ORM
- Component Reference Documentation
- Educational Platforms
- Monorepo Development
- React Server Components
- Invoice Generation Systems

## Salesforce PDF Generation Systems

- [LWCPDF-Preview-Download Overview](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/1-overview): Overview of Salesforce Lightning dual PDF generation architecture
- [PDF Generation Systems](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/2-pdf-generation-systems): Two distinct PDF generation architectures for Salesforce LWC
- [LwcPdfGenerate System](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/2.1-lwcpdfgenerate-system): Primary invoice-style PDF generation with three-tier architecture
- [pdfGeneratorLWC System](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/2.2-pdfgeneratorlwc-system): Modern LWC PDF generation with client-side blob manipulation
- [BillingPdfGenerate Service](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/2.3-billingpdfgenerate-service): Backend Apex service for billing PDF generation and Visualforce rendering
- [Architecture & Data Flow](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/4-architecture-and-data-flow): System architecture, component interactions, and data flow analysis
- [Development Guide](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/5-development-guide): Developer guide for Salesforce PDF generation setup and deployment

## Salesforce Component Reference

- [Component Reference](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/3-component-reference): Technical reference for LWC, Apex, and Visualforce components
- [Lightning Web Components](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/3.1-lightning-web-components): LWC component structure and implementation reference documentation
- [Apex Controllers](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/3.2-apex-controllers): Apex controller reference for PDF generation architectural patterns
- [Visualforce Templates](https://deepwiki.com/07hasib/LWCPDF-Preview-Download/3.3-visualforce-templates): Visualforce PDF template structure and data binding patterns

## MentaMática Educational Platform

- [MentaMática Overview](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/1-overview): MentaMática educational mathematics platform architecture overview
- [System Architecture](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/3-system-architecture): MentaMática monorepo structure and Next.js full-stack architecture
- [Frontend System](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/4-frontend-system): Next.js frontend with React Server Components and Clerk authentication
- [Authentication Middleware](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/4.2-authentication-middleware): Clerk-based route protection and access control middleware
- [Backend System](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/5-backend-system): Next.js backend with Drizzle ORM and Neon PostgreSQL integration
- [Development Environment](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/2-development-environment): Full-stack development workflow orchestration and npm scripts

- [Next.js Development Server](https://deepwiki.com/07Humberto-Mueses/mentamatica_app/4.1-next.js-development-server): Next.js dev server with HMR, request tracing, and performance monitoring
